name: searchcarriers-risk-engine
description: Risk scoring, vetting checks, insurance validation, and compliance auditing for motor carriers.

tools.name: risk_score
tools.description: Calculate a composite risk score for a carrier based on safety, insurance, and authority data.

tools.name: vetting_check
tools.description: Run carrier through qualification rules and return pass/review/fail verdict.

tools.name: insurance_check
tools.description: Validate insurance coverage status, active policies, and gap detection.

tools.name: compliance_audit
tools.description: Audit MCS-150 filing, authority status, and regulatory compliance posture.

author: Jeremy Longshore <jeremy@intentsolutions.io>
